fieldValues.title: An essay has nowhere to keep the exploration it grows from
fieldValues.statement: I start an essay by exploring: conversations with agents through chat, the CLI or the web, source material, quotes, ideas tested one small question at a time, and for a narrative the timelines, characters, events and themes. That material ends up in chats and inside the fields of the claims it produced, so I cannot read the original conversation apart from the structured records that emerged from it, trace a claim back to what was said, or keep the conversation open while I write.
